summary: 04-05 boilerplate survey + shared scripture chunk-config (chapter:verse labels)
description: Nodes 04 (boilerplate-survey) + 05 (chunk-config) — the highest-leverage judgement. STRATEGY DECIDED: 'paragraph-group' with max_tokens=800 (the corpus-standard ceiling — 420/421 configs use 800), where the grouped unit is the VERSE. Pack consecutive verses into a chunk up to the 800-token ceiling, ALWAYS breaking on a verse boundary (never mid-verse), and label each chunk by the chapter:verse RANGE it spans (e.g. genesis-asv '1:1-11', a chapter-crossing group '1:29-2:3'). This gives coherent ~800-tok retrieval units while every boundary is a real verse boundary and citations resolve to a verse range. Shared config reused across all three books: chunking/biblical/{id}.toml. Residual apparatus stripped via pre_strip_patterns. Record reasoning in docs/ingest/decisions/{id}.md (why verse-atomic-to-ceiling over pure-pericope and over verse-per-chunk). DONE: 'python3 scripts/chunk.py --dry-run --only <id>' prints chapter:verse-range labels for each with NO mid-verse splits; decision doc written; node marked done in ledger.
